A.domain: Subtracting fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Equalize fraction units
skills.definition: Find a common denominator and rewrite fractional parts as equivalent fractions before subtraction when the denominators differ.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator.
Tag when a step converts one or both fractions to equivalent fractions with the same denominator.
Tag in mixed-number subtraction if only the fractional parts need denominator alignment.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when the fractions already have the same denominator and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag simple rewriting of a whole number as n + 0/d unless it is part of denominator matching with an existing denominator.
Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed number such as 2 4/3 to 3 1/3 unless a new common denominator is also being found.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract quantities once they are in compatible form, including numerators of like fractions and the whole and fractional parts of mixed numbers when no borrowing is needed.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step subtracts numerators of fractions with the same denominator.
Tag when a step subtracts whole parts and/or fractional parts of mixed numbers directly.
Tag when a step subtracts after common denominators have already been established.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag steps whose main purpose is finding a common denominator or converting equivalent fractions.
Do not tag borrowing or regrouping steps where 1 whole is converted into fractional units.
Do not tag simplification-only steps such as reducing 2/10 to 1/5 or 0/3 to 0.

skills.name: Regroup or normalize
skills.definition: Rewrite a quantity into a subtraction-ready form by normalizing an improper mixed number or by borrowing one whole and converting it into fractional units when the fractional subtraction would otherwise be negative.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a mixed number with an improper fraction part is normalized, such as 2 3/2 to 3 1/2.
Tag when a whole or mixed number is rewritten to support borrowing, such as 3 to 3 + 0/5.
Tag when 1 whole is borrowed and converted into d/d to continue the subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary subtraction steps that do not involve rewriting structure.
Do not tag finding a common denominator between unlike denominators unless borrowing or normalization also occurs in that step.
Do not tag final combining or simplification steps.

skills.name: Simplify and express result
skills.definition: Reduce the result to lowest terms and present it in an appropriate final form such as a fraction, mixed number, or integer.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction is reduced, such as 2/10 to 1/5 or 9/12 to 3/4.
Tag when 0 over a denominator is simplified to 0.
Tag when whole and fractional parts are combined into a final mixed number or integer.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag subtraction steps unless they also explicitly simplify or combine into final form.
Do not tag denominator-finding or equivalent-fraction conversion steps.
Do not tag borrowing or normalization steps unless the step's main action is final simplification or expression.

B.domain: Subtracting fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Equalize fraction units
skills.definition: Make fractional parts directly comparable by using a common denominator or by rewriting a whole number as a fraction with denominator 0/n when needed.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution explicitly finds an LCD/common denominator and converts one or both fractions to equivalent fractions.
Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0/n so its fractional part can be subtracted against another fraction.
Tag when mixed-number fraction parts are rewritten to a shared denominator before subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when the fractions already have the same denominator and no rewriting to a common denominator is performed.
Do not tag pure normalization of an improper mixed number such as 2 4/3 to 3 1/3 unless a denominator-matching rewrite is also done.
Do not tag simplification after subtraction.

skills.name: Normalize mixed-number form
skills.definition: Rewrite a mixed number that has an improper fractional part into a standard whole-plus-proper-fraction form before subtracting.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution converts a mixed number like 2 3/2 or 1 4/3 into an equivalent standard mixed number.
Tag when this normalization is done to either the minuend or subtrahend before subtraction begins.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary decomposition of a mixed number into whole and fraction parts when the fractional part is already proper.
Do not tag rewriting a whole number as a + 0/n; that belongs to denominator alignment work.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping during subtraction.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract the quantities once forms are aligned, including subtracting numerators of like fractions and subtracting whole and fractional parts of mixed numbers when no borrowing is needed.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution subtracts fractions with a common denominator by subtracting numerators.
Tag when the solution subtracts whole parts and fraction parts of mixed numbers directly.
Tag when the solution combines the direct subtraction results into a final fraction, mixed number, or integer, provided no borrowing step is required.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag steps whose main purpose is to create a common denominator or rewrite forms before subtraction.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping steps used because the fractional part would otherwise be negative.
Do not tag simplification-only steps such as reducing 2/10 to 1/5 or 0/3 to 0.

skills.name: Borrow and simplify
skills.definition: Regroup one whole into fractional units when the fractional subtraction would be negative, and reduce the resulting fraction or zero to lowest terms.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution borrows 1 from the whole part and converts it to n/n added to the fractional part.
Tag when the solution then completes the subtraction after regrouping.
Tag when the solution simplifies a resulting fraction or zero, such as 2/10 to 1/5, 9/12 to 3/4, or 0/3 to 0.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag direct subtraction cases where no regrouping or simplification is performed.
Do not tag initial denominator-finding or normalization steps.
Do not tag direct subtraction of already aligned parts unless it occurs as part of the post-borrow computation.

C.domain: Subtracting fractions and mixed numbers, including unlike denominators, borrowing, normalization, and simplification

skills.name: Equalize fraction units
skills.definition: Find a common denominator and rewrite fractions as equivalent fractions before subtraction when the fractional parts are not already in the same unit.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator.
Tag when a step converts one or both fractions to equivalent fractions so they share a denominator.
Tag in mixed-number subtraction when only the fractional parts are converted to a common denominator.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when the fractions already have the same denominator and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag for borrowing steps that change a whole into denominator/denominator.
Do not tag for simplification after subtraction.

skills.name: Normalize composite numbers
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole or mixed number into a subtraction-ready form, such as converting an improper mixed number to a standard mixed number or expressing a whole number as a whole plus 0 over a denominator.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a mixed number with an improper fractional part is normalized, such as 2 3/2 to 3 1/2.
Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0 over a denominator, such as 3 to 3 + 0/5.
Tag when a mixed number is explicitly decomposed into whole and fractional parts to align with the other quantity.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary subtraction of already-ready whole and fractional parts.
Do not tag finding a common denominator unless the step also rewrites the number's structure.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping after subtraction has begun.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract quantities once they are in compatible form, including subtracting numerators of like fractions and subtracting whole and fractional parts of mixed numbers, then combining the result.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when like-denominator fractions are subtracted by subtracting numerators.
Tag when whole parts and fraction parts of mixed numbers are subtracted separately without regrouping.
Tag when the solver combines the resulting whole and fractional parts into a final mixed number or fraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag denominator-conversion steps.
Do not tag normalization steps such as rewriting a whole as 0 over a denominator.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping steps used because the fractional subtraction would be negative.
Do not tag simplification-only steps.

skills.name: Regroup or simplify result
skills.definition: Adjust the subtraction result by borrowing from the whole part when the fractional difference is negative, and/or reduce the resulting fraction or zero form to lowest terms.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step borrows 1 from the whole part and converts it to denominator/denominator to continue subtraction.
Tag when a step simplifies a fraction to lowest terms after subtraction.
Tag when a step simplifies a zero fraction such as 0/3 to 0.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag routine subtraction when no borrowing or simplification occurs.
Do not tag initial rewriting of whole or mixed numbers before subtraction begins.
Do not tag common-denominator conversion before subtraction.
